upload.title: 퇴사 다음 날, 알람이 울지 않았다 | 평일 오후 세 시 #shorts
upload.description:
알람이 울지 않는 아침.
넥타이는 옷장 속에서 잠이 들었습니다.

카프카 『변신』의 그레고르처럼, 퇴사 다음 날 나는 벌레가 된 것만 같았습니다.
그런데 평일 오후 세 시, 처음 보는 햇살 아래서 딸아이가 물었습니다. "아빠 오늘 회사 안 가?"
오늘은 너한테 출근했어.

🎵 평일 오후 세 시 - MIDLIFE COMMUTER
💬 회사 대신 처음 '출근'한 곳은 어디였나요? 댓글로 들려주세요. 다음 노래가 됩니다.

가사는 사람이 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.

scenes.plate: a small Korean apartment bedroom in soft morning light seen at eye level, plain walls, a low wooden nightstand on the left with a tiny palm-sized round alarm clock on it showing half past seven, thin curtains glowing with sunlight
scenes.motion: the man stands still with tired eyes and glances down at the tiny silent alarm clock, the thin curtains sway softly, dust floats in the sunlight

scenes.plate: a Korean apartment bedroom with a tall wooden wardrobe on the right side, its doors wide open showing a row of neckties and white shirts and dark suits hanging neatly, morning light, plain wall on the left
scenes.motion: the man stands still on the left and looks at the open wardrobe, nothing inside moves, morning light slowly slides across the floor, the camera pushes in gently

scenes.plate: a dim Korean apartment bedroom at late morning seen at eye level, curtains half closed with a thin line of sunlight, a plain wall, an empty wooden floor in the middle of the room
scenes.motion: the man lies still under the thick blanket and slowly blinks, staring blankly, the thin line of sunlight trembles on the wall, the curtain moves a little

scenes.plate: a quiet empty Korean apartment living room at midday, a sofa, a low table with a cold cup of coffee, a wall clock, children's school bags gone from their hooks, flat grey light
scenes.motion: the man stands alone in the silent living room and lowers his shoulders, the wall clock's second hand ticks, the light slowly brightens through the window

scenes.plate: a bright Korean apartment complex walkway on a sunny weekday afternoon seen at eye level, golden ginkgo trees, warm sunlight and long soft shadows, flower beds, a clear blue sky, nobody on the path
scenes.motion: the man looks up into the warm afternoon sunlight with surprise, golden ginkgo leaves float down around him, branches sway gently

scenes.plate: a small cozy Korean apartment playground on a sunny afternoon seen at eye level, a sandbox and a low wooden climbing frame behind, golden ginkgo trees and apartment buildings in the back
scenes.motion: the two children laugh and bounce happily in front of the slide, the man watches them with a soft smile, golden leaves drift down

scenes.plate: the front entrance hallway (hyeongwan) inside a Korean apartment in the afternoon, plain cream walls, a closed white shoe cabinet, family shoes neatly on the floor, a closed front door, warm soft light from the living room
scenes.motion: the little girl tilts her head and looks up at her father with curious eyes, the father smiles warmly and nods, soft light flickers on the wall, the room stays still and calm

scenes.plate: a pedestrian-only walking path inside a Korean apartment complex on a sunny afternoon, golden ginkgo trees and flower beds on both sides, apartment buildings behind, no road
scenes.motion: the father and his little daughter walk side by side along the path, the girl swings her arms happily, golden leaves fall around them

scenes.plate: a sunny Korean apartment kitchen in the morning, breakfast on the table, a frying pan with eggs on the stove, a window with morning sun, a silent alarm clock on the counter
scenes.motion: steam rises from the frying pan, the children laugh and chatter, the man smiles at them warmly, morning sunlight fills the kitchen

scenes.plate: a walking path along a small stream in a Korean neighborhood park on a sunny afternoon, reeds and golden trees by the water, apartment buildings far behind
scenes.motion: the family stands together by the stream laughing, the wife leans toward her husband, the children point at the water, reeds sway in the wind

scenes.plate: a garden lawn inside a Korean apartment complex at golden sunset, ginkgo trees with golden leaves, long warm shadows, apartment buildings glowing behind
scenes.motion: the father and daughter stand together in the golden sunset light and smile at each other, golden leaves drift down slowly

scenes.plate: a window of a Korean apartment at sunset seen from inside, warm orange sky over the apartment complex, a child's crayon drawing of a smiling dad taped to the glass
scenes.motion: the man stands still by the window and gazes at the warm sunset sky with a calm face, clouds drift slowly, the sky glows orange
